literal: Properly having investigated, further not happening by the manner, suitably punishing is king.
translation: A king investigates a crime properly and punishes it proportionately, in a manner that ensures it does not happen again.
modern: ஒரு குற்றத்தை முறையாக ஆராய்ந்து, அக்குற்றம் மீண்டும் நிகழாத வகையில், குற்றத்திற்கு ஏற்றவாறு தண்டிப்பதே அரசனின் கடமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the purpose and measure of royal justice. The king must first investigate a fault thoroughly. Then, he must issue a punishment that fits the crime, with the ultimate goal being deterrence so that the offense does not occur again. The emphasis is on proportionate justice rather than excessive cruelty.
